text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Katsuragi Ace was enjoying a 
barbecue with her friends.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, dig in, everyone! There's plenty 
of meat and veggies to go around!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food! ...Huh? Isn't that 
C.B. over there?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sure is. Wait, in that direction there's 
definitely a river... ...Alright, you guys 
start eating without me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The air is so crisp... Fufu, what a lovely 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: The water looks cool and refreshing too—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Here goes! Ahahaha! What a huge splash!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, a freshwater crab. Sorry about 
that, did I startle you? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo, C.B.! Having fun all by yourself over 
here?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ace. I saw the river and just couldn't 
resist wading in.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And got yourself soaking wet, huh? Here, 
dry off before you catch a cold. I brought 
a towel for you.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And have this too! Playing in the water 
makes you pretty thirsty, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Now that you mention it. Fufu, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Sure! More importantly, aren't you hungry? 
We're having a barbecue over that way!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A barbecue... Yeah, sounds good. Mind if I 
drop by?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what is happening right now?! C.B. 
actually joins events like this?!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
A-And she's even handling the grilling! 
This is an academy bulletin-worthy scoop!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, looks nice. If I do say so myself, it 
turned out pretty great.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! It's super delicious! ...Wait, why 
are you on grill duty, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe because I wanted to be 
wrapped in all these delicious aromas?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—C.B., just say the word whenever you want 
to eat. I'll take over grill duty.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Hey, Ace, what are you in the mood 
for?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're gonna grill for me? Well don't 
mind if I take you up on that!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I'll grill up something truly special for 
you. Meat, veggies, whatever you like.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Dealer's choice! Surprise me with 
your recommendation!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... Hmm. ...This is actually 
pretty tricky to decide... fufu.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Anything is fine! Just knowing you're 
cooking it makes me happy!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about this charred black 
bit shoved off to the side—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hey, whoa! That's not what I meant at all!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, just kidding. A huge pile of 
veggies, right? I know you like those.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, count me in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back after finishing work, I 
ran into students returning from their 
outing.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
That barbecue was so much fun~. When 
should we do the next one? Let me go ask 
Ace!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Come to think of it, where is Ace? 
She's usually right at the front—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Way in the back... wait, C.B. is with her! 
It's so rare for C.B. to stay till the 
very end, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Probably because Ace is with her, right? 
Look, they're not even talking, but the 
vibe between them is so great.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so true! Fufu, feels like total 
telepathy between them!
